# Improve codebase architecture (Matt Pocock)

Scans a codebase for places to deepen modules and presents them as a visual HTML report.

- Source: https://github.com/mattpocock/skills
- SKILL.md: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mattpocock/skills/main/skills/engineering/improve-codebase-architecture/SKILL.md
- Author: Matt Pocock
- License: MIT
- Page: https://commandvault.ai/commands/improve-codebase-architecture-matt-pocock-f36398c8

Claude looks across the codebase for shallow modules and tangled boundaries that could be simplified into deeper ones, writes the options up as an HTML report, and then questions you about whichever one you choose before changing anything. Manual use only (run /improve-codebase-architecture). Includes a report template and agent prompts.

**Try asking:**
- "/improve-codebase-architecture"
- "/improve-codebase-architecture focusing on the billing module"
- "/improve-codebase-architecture for src/server"
